sources.text:
## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

sources.title: Refunds policy
sources.text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

sources.title: Escalation and human handover
sources.section_title: When to hand over to a human
sources.text:
## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

sources.title: Delivery and shipping policy
sources.text:
## [DEL-4] Late deliveries
If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

sources.title: Delivery and shipping policy
sources.text:
## [DEL-3] Delivery attempts
The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.

sources.title: Returns policy
sources.text:
## [RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

sources.title: Returns policy
sources.text:
## [RET-8] Festive sale returns
Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.

sources.title: Delivery and shipping policy
sources.text:
## [DEL-1] Delivery times
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.
